name: PT Pelayaran Nasional Bina Buana Raya Tbk
summary: PT Pelayaran Nasional Bina Buana Raya Tbk, a shipping company, provides marine, logistics, and offshore support services in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Self Propelled Barge Vessel; and Offshore Support Vessel. The Self Propelled Barge Vessel segment provides transportation services for mining materials, such as coal, granite, and sand through transshipment or river and coastal routes; and The Offshore Support Vessel segment provides vessel rental services to oil and gas companies on a time-chartered system. PT Pelayaran Nasional Bina Buana Raya Tbk was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
